item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadiy-a ǰinamitr-a kiged silendr-a bodhi-luγ-a yeke üǰegči kelemürči bande yesisde orčiγulǰu nayiraγuluγad orusiγulbai, kunga odzer manǰusri pandita-dur dulduyidču darqan nangsu mongγol-un kelen-dür orčiγulǰu nayiraγul-un orusiγulbai,
